usual_baseline: A NELA score is often calculated but rarely shared. Score recorded 21–39.6% at some sites [2403][2547], 80–94.7% at others [2139][2683]. Mortality risk on the consent form 17.86–40% [2683][2558]; discussion with patient or family documented 14% [2038]. Frailty assessed in 38.6% of over-65s [2547]; elderly care input 12.5% [2683].
fix_that_works: Periodic reminders to surgeons at meetings plus posters, over three cycles [2558]. Mortality on the consent form rose from 40% to 71% to 92% (p < 0.0001).
fix_that_fails: In the same audit, documented discussion in the medical notes rose only from 35% to 51% [2558]. No other intervention was re-audited.
consultant_advice: Only one of six audits closed the loop; the rest are baselines with the same finding. The score gets done for NELA, not for the patient. Audit whether the risk is discussed and recorded in the notes, and whether frailty and elderly care input happen for older patients.
